game.name: Withering Rooms
game.short_description: Withering Rooms is a challenging 2.5D horror RPG set in a procedurally generated Victorian mansion that changes each night. Explore Mostyn House to collect the perfect items for your build and face a huge cast of overgrown undead, invisible ghosts, devious witches, and more.

commentary.label: Top 10 of 2024 (#7)
commentary.summary: Withering Rooms is a 2.5D action horror roguelike mixing stealth and soulslike mechanics in a surprisingly large adventure. You play a young girl who starts out weak and hiding from monsters, then grows into a fighter or wizard. He calls it the most surprising and interesting game on his list, feeling more like an action horror adventure than a typical roguelike. Despite UI, repetition and weak-boss complaints, he highly recommends it to anyone wanting a different roguelike experience.
praise: Surprising scope: keeps expanding until it feels like a massive adventure game
Intentionally slow, simple, clunky gameplay that supports the vulnerable start
Progression from helpless hiding to becoming a true fighter or wizard
Hardcore death system that sends you back to chapter start, making combat risky and frightening
Remembrance shrines let you pay to permanently keep items, an interesting player decision
Curse rot mechanic changes visuals, audio and gameplay, with fantastic effort put into the changes
Strong sense of adventure and unique monsters
criticism: Map and inventory UI could use better filters and player feedback
Gets repetitive by the end despite its size
Player became so overpowered as to be near invincible
Many bosses look cool but are mechanically uninteresting, and infinite lives in boss fights reduce the threat
unique_points: Permadeath treated as a hardcore chapter-reset death system rather than a full run reset, keeping levels and permanent items
Curse meter that rises with horrifying events and transforms the world and mechanics
Roguelike elements (random loot, rings with randomized stats) serve an action horror adventure
commentary.quote: I cannot deny how unique and surprising withering rooms was to me
design_criteria: Risk vs reward: hardcore death and loot loss make combat frightening
Meta-progression: remembrance shrines to permanently keep items
Atmosphere/visuals/audio: curse-driven changes to the world
Boss design: visually cool but mechanically shallow, infinite lives reduce threat
UI/usability: map and inventory filtering and feedback
Pacing/repetition: large game that gets repetitive late
Exploration/adventure feel: sense of expanding world
